referenceRoles: Approved seated sprites are edit targets; user-supplied two stills are gesture references only.
fiery:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Edit IMAGE1, the APPROVED Kiana Fiery Wishing Star twelve-frame seated listening sprite sheet (3 columns x4 rows).
IMAGE1 is the absolute identity, rendering, color, proportions, costume, eyes and LOWER BODY reference. Images2 and3 are ONLY gesture inspiration: relaxed gentle side-to-side head tilting and a tiny forward nod while listening. Do not copy their character, colors, simplified style or closed-eye expression.
CHANGE ONLY the upper torso above the waist, shoulders, neck, head and attached hair/headphones: redraw a connected, natural, softly swaying sequence, head tilting distinctly but gently from about 8 degrees viewer-left in first pose toward 8 degrees viewer-right by last pose. Twelve successive tilt keyframes in reading order: -8,-7,-6,-4,-2,0,+2,+4,+6,+7,+8,+8 degrees. Shoulders/upper torso lean only about3 degrees with it, head slightly nods down around middle; the neck joins naturally, head and hair follow. A relaxed happy listening expression, not melancholy or sleeping. KEEP OPEN lively purple-cyan star-highlight eyes, their original eye shape, highlight placements and intensity, small gentle smile; eyes move with head perspective, not repainted in another style. Do not add new modes.
STRICT LOCK: all twelve existing hip/seat directions, thighs, knees, calves, shoes and foot-swing poses, lower costume, round red gold-trim flower stool and all leg/foot positions remain exactly as corresponding cells in IMAGE1. Do not change the leg sequence, leg bend angles, stool size, butt contact or lower-body drawing. Do not rotate the whole sprite. Draw whole complete characters frame by frame, no separated limbs, no pasted cutout head or visible neck seam.
Preserve each original head's SIZE, compact chibi head/body ratio, silver-white hair with restrained gray-lavender shadows, hair highlights, thin soft violet-gray outlines, restrained red/black/gold costume palette and floral red earcups. Same crisp detailed illustrated rendering, no extra saturation, no blue/gray hair cast, no heavier outlines, no eye enlargement. Head roll and shoulder sway must be visibly different between first/middle/last rows, not twelve copies of one pose.
Same 3x4 layout, figure positions and complete full bodies. Leave transparent gutters so tilted hair and headpieces are never cropped. Transparent alpha background. No text, ground shadow, glow, outline halo, dust or background. Preview only.
winter:
Precise identity-preserving edit of IMAGE1, the approved Kiana Winter Wish seated music animation sheet. Preserve EXACTLY TWELVE full figures in the same THREE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS (3 figures in each of four rows, including bottom row). Image1 is the absolute visual/style and pose master. Images2/3 ONLY inspire the gentle listening head-tilt; do not copy their art style, colors, character or closed eyes.
Modify ONLY head, neck, shoulders and torso ABOVE the waist to add natural side-to-side head swaying with a little shoulder sway and soft nod. Row1 heads lean left (left eye on image slightly LOWER than right); row2 gradually settle toward upright; row3 gradually lean right; row4 rightward tilt (left eye slightly HIGHER than right). About7–8 degrees each side, torso3 degrees, pelvis stays fixed. The head must remain organically joined to neck, no sticker/pivot look.
Absolutely preserve each original cell's lower torso/hips, thighs, knees, calves, shoes, leg-swing pose and blue-white round star-and-bow stool. Match original figure placement and size. Keep all twelve DIFFERENT original leg poses in their exact original reading order. No whole-body rotation, no separated limbs.
Preserve the approved silver-white hair with subtle neutral lavender-gray shadows and highlights, fine soft violet-gray outline, same eye size and lively violet-to-cyan irises and star glints, gentle smile, tiny compact chibi body, exact icy blue-white costume, ice crystal crown and blue snowflake headphones. Keep eyes open as original; do not make sleepy/dull or enlarge eyes. No blue/purple cast added to white hair, no color saturation increase, no thicker lines.
Crisp whole-character painted animation keyframes. Same3x4 canvas layout, ample transparent gutters for head tilt, no clipping of hair/crown/shoes. Actual transparent background, no text, backdrop, glow, shadow or colored halo. DO NOT OMIT ROW FOUR. Twelve complete drawings. CRITICAL exact cell correspondence: four rows must remain, with original DIFFERENT leg swings in rows1,2,3,4. Preserve the hips, skirts, bare thighs, boots and stool from each corresponding cell; modify the head and upper torso only, do not redraw the leg motion into generic together-legs.
